title: Philo Is Now One of the Best (And Most Affordable) Streaming Services for Live TV: Here’s How to Sign Up
summary: Starting at $25, enjoy live TV streaming, a deep library of on demand movies and shows, and a free trial.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Streaming continues to dominate the TV and movie watching experience at home. With many people moving away from traditional cable, streaming your favorite movies and TV shows from popular services can start to add up. With Philo , customers get the best of both words, a variety of live TV channels and a a deep library of on-demand titles all at an impressively affordable price point.

For customers who want even more, upgrading to Bundle+ (formerly Philo Core) includes everything in the Essential plan plus AMC+, access to HBO Max (Basic with Ads) and discovery+ for $33 per month , $8 more than Essential. However, Bundle+ does not include access to the free trial.
